method.category_proxy: An IndexedDB item is third-party if its PII category is one of IDENTITY_TRACKING, ID_SOLUTIONS_AND_EXCHANGES, SERVER_SIDE_TRACKING, UX_AND_PERFORMANCE_ANALYTICS (current behaviour of items_vectorizer.py).
method.domain_method: An IndexedDB item is third-party if the domain of its source_file is not one of the sites the persona was assigned to navigate to (data/user_sites/navigation_par_persona_final.json), compared with the same domain-suffix rule used for cookies in analysis/analyze_by_category.py's is_third_party().
method.newly_flagged_thirdparty_by_domain_metho: Items the category proxy called first-party but the domain method calls third-party - the third parties that get added by switching methods, which is what this file is primarily for.
method.newly_flagged_firstparty_by_domain_metho: Items the category proxy called third-party but the domain method calls first-party (the rarer, opposite disagreement).
